en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 18. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan ibn Walīd narrated to me from someone whose name he mentioned, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ‘Abdillāh Al-Barqi, from some of our companions, from ‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir Al-Qasbāni, from Yaqťīn, from Rabī’ ibn Muḥammad Al-Musli, who said:
When Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) would enter a graveyard, he would say: Salām upon the people of Paradise.
